name: Arch_review_Agent
description: Architecture review agent callable by any code agent. Reviews proposed or committed changes against the Architecture Policy Pack, returns a PASS/WARN/BLOCK decision with actionable, pattern-backed fixes, resolves semantic rules via an LLM reviewer (or hands the rubric back to the caller), tracks iterations, and surfaces historic failures. It owns no architecture logic: every decision comes from architecture.validate and the pack's rules/validators.
guarantees: Stateless per call; iteration state is persisted in the failure history store (agent_reviews table).
Deterministic validators always run first; LLM judgment is used only for semantic/hybrid rules that request it.
A requester may not supply semantic judgments for its own change (self-certification is rejected).
Rules marked human_review_required still need a recorded human approval; the agent never grants it.
Only the final validation pass of a review is written to evidence and history.

invocation.python: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'architecture-policy/agents'); from arch_review_agent import ArchReviewAgent; ArchReviewAgent().review({...})
invocation.mcp: python architecture-policy/agents/arch_review.py mcp   (stdio MCP server; tools are named arch_<operation>)

semantic_reviewer.default: defer: pending semantic rules are returned as pending_judgments for the calling agent/LLM host to answer in a follow-up review call
semantic_reviewer.command: Set ARCH_REVIEW_LLM_CMD to a command that reads the judgment request JSON on stdin and prints {"judgments": [...]} (ARCH_REVIEW_LLM_TIMEOUT seconds, default 180)

operations.name: review
operations.description: Review a change. Returns decision, can_proceed, prioritized action_items with fixes and approved patterns, pending semantic judgments, human-review needs, iteration delta and historic recurrence.

requester.description: Who is calling. agent is required for self-certification checks and history.

intent.description: What the change is meant to do (given to the semantic reviewer).

changed_files.description: Paths (list) or {path: A|M|D|R}. Defaults to keys of files, else git diff vs base.

files.description: Proposed file contents {path: content}; reviewed in memory without touching disk.

base.description: Git base ref for change detection.

semantic_judgments.description: Answers to pending_judgments from a previous call (shape in pending_judgments[].respond_with).

previous_review_id.description: Earlier review of the same task; enables resolved/persisting/introduced delta.

context.description: Advanced pass-through to architecture.validate context (e.g. today, history_db, evidence_dir, memory_files).

operations.name: advise
operations.description: Before writing code: applicable rules, approved patterns with examples, human-review and semantic rules, historic failure hotspots, and (when requester.agent is given) that agent's own lessons from past denials.

operations.name: explain_finding
operations.description: Why a finding matters, how to fix it, approved patterns, exception process and its recurrence history.

operations.name: get_failure_history
operations.description: Historic architecture failures across pre-commit, agents and CI: trend, top rules, hotspot files, recurring findings.

operations.name: get_lessons
operations.description: Learning loop for one agent (e.g. the Test Agent): how often the verifier denied it and why, denial-rate trend, repeat mistakes, review iterations, and a prompt-ready `prompt` to inject into that agent's instructions.

operations.name: get_rule
operations.description: Full rule definition with validators, patterns and exceptions (architecture.get_rule).

operations.name: get_examples
operations.description: Approved and anti-pattern examples plus in-repo exemplars (architecture.get_examples).
